sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((NOT (jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) <> 'null')), false)))
